title: An acyclic resolution representing the specified finite affine section complex
statement: Let f:X\to T be a separated quasi-compact morphism of schemes with affine T [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], and let F be a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent]. Let V:Fin(r)\to X.Opens be a finite affine open cover. Write G=f_* for ordinary module direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] and C=finiteAffineCechModel(f,F,V) [def-pc-finite-affine-cech-model]. There exist a complex D in nonnegative degrees of X-modules and an augmentation epsilon:F[0]\to D which is a quasi-isomorphism, whose every term is G-right-acyclic [def-sp-acyclic], and a chain isomorphism G(D extended by zero to integer degrees)\cong C. No derived localizations are supplied and no total derived isomorphism is part of this assertion.

source.place: Tags 01XB, 01XD, 01FK, 01FM and 01I6; increasing-tuple sheaf resolution and termwise affine tilde-Gamma identification

proof.text: Put a=T.toSpecGamma, an isomorphism because T is affine. Take the identity base change of f followed by a. The tensor pullback is additive by its existing adjunction and additivity of its right adjoint. Apply exists_affineAlternatingCech_augmented_construction to f followed by a and the given cover. Retain the nonnegative complex D, augmentation epsilon, its quasi-isomorphism, the ordinary pushed-complex isomorphism q and its finite-product term descriptions. Discard the additional pulled-back quasi-isomorphism. All existential witnesses are consumed inside this proof; no definition chooses one.

Prove affine right-acyclicity directly using the fully proved source rightAcyclic_of_epi_map_g dimension-shifting criterion. Use the class of module sheaves whose underlying abelian sheaves are Cech-acyclic on affine opens. Quasi-coherent modules belong by exactAt_cechComplex_basicOpen; injective modules belong because their underlying sheaves are flasque. This class is closed under cokernels of monomorphisms by cechAcyclicOnAffines_X3. An affine morphism sends a short exact sequence with kernel in this class to an epimorphism on the right: lift sections on affine inverse images using surjective_app_of_cechAcyclicOnAffines and use epi_of_forall_exists_app_eq. Thus affine_rightAcyclic is proved, with no appeal to the cyclic AffineMorphism module. For each affine open W, its composite to T is affine and separatedness of f then gives affineness of W inclusion into X. Restriction of F is quasi-coherent. Apply affine_rightAcyclic to both maps. The open_pushforward_rightDerived_comparison identifies each positive right-derived image of f_*j_* with that of (j followed by f)_*, which is zero. This proves each factor right-acyclic. Transport along the supplied term isomorphism and use rightAcyclic.prop_product for finite products, including the empty product.

Construct the natural isomorphism pushforward(f followed by a) followed by pullback(a) to pushforward(f): replace pullback(a) with pushforward(inv a), compose pushforwards, and cancel a followed by inv a. Apply mapHomologicalComplexCompIso at D extended to integer degrees. Its inverse identifies the ordinary f pushforward with pullback(a) of the spectrum-chart pushforward. Compose with mapIso(q) under pullback(a). The resulting target is definitionally finiteAffineCechModel f F V. Combine this isomorphism with epsilon quasi-isomorphic and the termwise acyclicity proved in the preceding step. No nonempty-cover assumption or choice of arbitrary data is made; zero and empty cases come from the existing construction and finite-product closure.

CechSheafResolution gives an unnormalized resolution without the increasing-tuple ordinary chain comparison. CechResolution has a private derived comparison, but its AffineOpenPushforwardAcyclic import reaches the item through AffineMorphism and FiniteFreeComplex. AffineAlternatingCechResolutionCore requires universal derived-category instances and base-change data and also has a transitive import cycle. No usable exact underived resolution for this model.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteAffineCechModel_acyclic_resolution
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) [IsAffine T] [IsSeparated f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    {r : ℕ} (V : Fin r → X.Opens) (hV : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (V i))
    (hcover : iSup V = ⊤) :
    ∃ (D : CochainComplex X.Modules ℕ)
      (ε : (CochainComplex.single₀ X.Modules).obj F ⟶ D),
      QuasiIso ε ∧
      (∀ p, (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightAcyclic (D.X p)) ∧
      Nonempty (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (D.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) ≅
          finiteAffineCechModel f F V)
